		%c[0,255,255,255]To: %c[0,170,170,170]"Reconnaissance Squad"

		%c[0,255,255,255]"Re: %c[0,170,170,170]Locate and neutralize the runaway scientists"

		%c[0,255,255,255]件名：%c[0,170,170,170]逃亡した科学者を発見し、無力化せよ
 

		「人員記録によれば、遠征部隊に所属する科学者2名の所在が分からなくなっている。1名は通常の測定中に荒野で姿を消した。もう1名は逃走時に重傷を負いながら、追跡を振り切った。行方不明者は徒歩で移動しており、装備は限られ、自衛手段もない。まだ作戦区域内にいる可能性が高い。区域を捜索し、所在を突き止めろ。遺体を発見した場合は身元を確実に確認し、生存していれば処分する。交戦規定は、対象および抵抗する敵対勢力への発砲を許可する。」

%c[0,255,255,255]From: %c[0,170,170,170]"Col. Musorenko"

		%c[0,255,255,255]To: %c[0,170,170,170]"Reconnaissance Squad"

		%c[0,255,255,255]"Re: %c[0,170,170,170]Obtain data on the "ZNOY-13" research project"
 

		"You will be airdropped by helo in the vicinity of the Yantar area. Once you regroup on the ground, your objective will be to reach the X-16 clandestine complex. It is impossible to penetrate the vicinity of the lab without an experienced guide, so we have secured the cooperation of a Freedom operative who is familiar with the area and will RV with you at grid X-ray 215 Yankee 102. Once you breach the objective, conduct a search of the premises for any documentation related to the "ZNOY-13" research project. Once you are confident you have conducted a thorough sweep of the premises, return to the extraction point and send a long range encrypted radio transmission to notify HQ. Utilize red smoke to mark the landing site for evac."

%c[0,255,255,255]From: %c[0,170,170,170]"Konstantin Outrage"

		%c[0,255,255,255]To: %c[0,170,170,170]"The chastisers"

		%c[0,255,255,255]Re: %c[0,170,170,170]"Public execution"
 

		"Everything's falling into place. The Military believe us and are convinced we know nothing about "ZNOY-13". Soon, we will have the money and when the Military sees the execution video, the Duty base will be gone. After these matters have been dealt with we'll turn our attention over to Lukash as well.

		I'll stay at Yantar, by the entrance to the X-16 lab. The Military informed me of a possible Merc raid inbound towards the facility. It seems that someone's offering big money to have something retrieved down there. No other explanation for Mercs knowing about "ZNOY-13". I also suspect Musorenko is not putting everything he knows into words."

entries.JA_new:
%c[0,255,255,255]差出人：%c[0,170,170,170]コンスタンチン・アウトレイジ

		%c[0,255,255,255]宛先：%c[0,170,170,170]処刑人たち

		%c[0,255,255,255]件名：%c[0,170,170,170]公開処刑
 

		すべて計画どおりに進んでいる。ミリタリーは俺たちを信じ、ZNOY-13のことは何も知らないと思い込んでいる。じきに金が手に入る。処刑映像をミリタリーが見れば、デューティー基地は消し飛ぶ。片がついたらルカシュにも手を回す。
 

		次は、無力な兵士をデューティーの兵士に殺させる、残虐な報復映像を撮ってもらう。処刑の後はデューティーの制服を必ず燃やせ。見つかったらどうなるか、言わなくても分かるな？
 

		俺はヤンターのX-16研究所入口にいる。施設へ向かうマーセナリーズの襲撃があるかもしれないと、ミリタリーから聞いた。誰かが地下から何かを回収させるため、大金を提示しているらしい。マーセナリーズがZNOY-13を知っている理由は、それ以外に考えられない。ムソレンコも、知っていることを全部話してはいないはずだ。
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]特性：

		%c[0,255,255,255] • %c[0,255,140,0]クエストアイテム

entries.EN:
%c[0,255,255,255]From: %c[0,170,170,170]"Col. Musorenko"

		%c[0,255,255,255]To: %c[0,170,170,170]"Assault Detachment"

		%c[0,255,255,255]Re: %c[0,170,170,170]"Capture the "ZNOY-13" samples case"
 

		"According to the intel obtained from stalkers of the Freedom faction, they did not make it in time to retrieve the case from Plahov. They asserted that a group of well-armed mercenaries had intercepted Plahov at the exit from the X-16 lab, fully aware of the case retrieved from within. The mercs threatened Plahov to give up the case containing the "ZNOY-13" specimens and disappeared heading East. Your mission is to intercept and eliminate this squad before they exfiltrate from the Zone with the case.
 

		As per latest intelligence data, a group of mercenaries has been spotted fairly recently around the Wild Territory with one of them reportedly carrying a case. It is imperative you seize the case by any means necessary. This is now your primary objective. All manner of lethal force is authorized and you're cleared hot against any op-for activity. Once you retrieve the case, evacuate the "ZNOY-13" samples to our science field team based at the Agroprom Research Institute ASAP."
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]PROPERTIES:

		%c[0,255,255,255] • %c[0,255,140,0]Quest Item

entries.JA_new:
%c[0,255,255,255]差出人：%c[0,170,170,170]ムソレンコ大佐

		%c[0,255,255,255]宛先：%c[0,170,170,170]突撃部隊

		%c[0,255,255,255]件名：%c[0,170,170,170]ZNOY-13のサンプルケースを確保せよ
 

		フリーダムのストーカーから得た情報によると、彼らはプラホフからケースを回収できなかった。武装したマーセナリーズの一団がX-16研究所の出口でプラホフを待ち伏せし、研究所から持ち出されたケースの存在も知っていたという。マーセナリーズはZNOY-13のサンプルが入ったケースを渡すようプラホフを脅し、東へ逃走した。ケースを持ってゾーンから脱出される前に、この一団を迎撃し、排除せよ。
 

		最新情報によると、荒廃領域で最近マーセナリーズの一団が目撃され、そのうち一人がケースを運んでいたらしい。いかなる手段を使ってもケースを確保しろ。これを最優先任務とする。敵対勢力に対しては、あらゆる致死的手段の使用を許可する。ケースを回収したら、ZNOY-13のサンプルをアフロプロム研究所に駐在する科学班へ至急届けろ。

entries.EN: There's something I was going to tell you, but I got tied up with something. Do you remember the turmoil with the Military at "Agroprom"?
entries.JA_current: There's something I was going to tell you, but I got tied up with something. Do you remember the turmoil with the Military at "Agroprom"?
entries.JA_new: 話しておこうと思ってたことがあるんだが、ちょっと手が離せなくてな。アフロプロムでミリタリーと揉めた件、覚えてるか？

entries.EN: Yes, I do. So what?
entries.JA_current: Yes, I do. So what?
entries.JA_new: ああ、覚えてる。それで？

entries.EN: Well, they're back over there searching for something again. Keep darting about and annoying the stalkers. One of the neutrals stopped by and told me. The other day our guys from Duty attempted to poke their noses into the Agroprom tunnels for some artifacts... You know, the "Fruit punch" bears delicious "Micas", and "Electro" keeps throwing "Sparklers" all over... So, apparently, the military gave it to them hard over there. Three good guys got killed at once... A squad was sent to retrieve the bodies and give them a decent burial, out of respect, and they never made it back either. So, I'm thinking, how about you take a look over there and scope out the situation? You're the only reliable, experienced guy I have on hand right about now, and I need a decent pair of eyes over there.

entries.JA_new: また何かを探しに戻ってきたらしい。あちこち動き回ってはストーカーを悩ませてるそうだ。ローナーの一人が教えてくれた。この前、デューティーの連中がアーティファクトを探しにアフロプロムの地下トンネルへ入ったんだ。「フルーツパンチ」にはうまい「マイカ」が実るし、「エレクトロ」は「スパークラー」をそこら中に撒き散らすだろ……ところがミリタリーにひどくやられたらしい。仲間が一度に3人も死んだ。遺体を回収して、敬意を込めて埋葬しようと部隊を送ったが、そいつらも戻らなかった。そこで、お前に様子を見てきてもらえないかと思ってな。今、頼れる経験者はお前だけだ。現地を見てきてほしい。

entries.EN: Sure, I will. But some ammo would come in handy.
entries.JA_current: Sure, I will. But some ammo would come in handy.
entries.JA_new: いいぜ。でも弾薬を少しもらえると助かる。

entries.EN: Thank you, Stalker, I appreciate this! Of course, I can spare plenty of boxes, what caliber are you after?
entries.JA_current: Thank you, Stalker, I appreciate this! Of course, I can spare plenty of boxes, what caliber are you after?
entries.JA_new: 助かるよ、ストーカー。感謝する！　弾薬ならいくらでも出せる。何口径がいい？

entries.EN: NATO, 5.56.
entries.JA_current: NATO, 5.56.
entries.JA_new: NATO弾、5.56ミリ。

entries.EN: The local specialty, 5.45.
entries.JA_current: The local specialty, 5.45.
entries.JA_new: こっちの定番、5.45ミリ。

entries.EN: PAB or SP, 9x39.
entries.JA_current: PAB or SP, 9x39.
entries.JA_new: PABかSP、9×39ミリ。

entries.EN: There you are, this enough? Ah, what the hell, take one more for good luck. So, head over to Agroprom, rendezvous with a Duty squad camped around there. They've been sent to conduct recon of the situation, talk to them. Let them fill you in on what they've observed and maybe they'll clarify the matter.
entries.JA_current: There you are, this enough? Ah, what the hell, take one more for good luck. So, head over to Agroprom, rendezvous with a Duty squad camped around there. They've been sent to conduct recon of the situation, talk to them. Let them fill you in on what they've observed and maybe they'll clarify the matter.
entries.JA_new: ほら、これで足りるか？　よし、運もつくようにもう一箱持ってけ。じゃあアフロプロムへ向かって、あそこで野営しているデューティーの分隊と合流しろ。状況を偵察するために派遣された連中だ。話を聞いて、見たものを教えてもらえ。何があったか分かるかもしれない。

entries.EN: Sir, yes sir!
entries.JA_current: Sir, yes sir!
entries.JA_new: 了解です、隊長！

entries.EN: You know, Barkeep, maybe some other time - I have my hands full now.
entries.JA_current: You know, Barkeep, maybe some other time - I have my hands full now.
entries.JA_new: バーキープ、悪いがまた今度な。今は手が離せないんだ。

entries.EN: Fuck off!
entries.JA_current: Fuck off!
entries.JA_new: 失せろ！

entries.EN: Hello, stalker! What are you doing out here?
entries.JA_current: Hello, stalker! What are you doing out here?
entries.JA_new: よう、ストーカー！　こんなところで何してる？

entries.EN: I'm here on behalf of the Barkeep. He sent me to find out what the fuck's been going on around here.
entries.JA_current: I'm here on behalf of the Barkeep. He sent me to find out what the fuck's been going on around here.
entries.JA_new: バーキープに頼まれて来た。この辺で何があったのか、話を聞かせろってさ。

entries.EN: Ha-ha-ha... Damn, I feel safer already! Well, look around, Sherlock! Fuckin' starship troopers came over and wasted all my fellas... That's what the fuck is going on around here! Instead of reinforcements, all I get is some guy who's gonna ask a bunch of questions to confirm what is obvious?!
entries.JA_current: Ha-ha-ha... Damn, I feel safer already! Well, look around, Sherlock! Fuckin' starship troopers came over and wasted all my fellas... That's what the fuck is going on around here! Instead of reinforcements, all I get is some guy who's gonna ask a bunch of questions to confirm what is obvious?!
entries.JA_new: ははは……ああ、これで安心だ！　ほら見てみろ、シャーロック！　クソッタレの宇宙海兵隊が乗り込んできて、仲間を皆殺しにしやがった……何があったかって？　増援の代わりに、当たり前のことを確かめるため質問する奴が来たってわけだ！

entries.EN: Watch your language, man!
entries.JA_current: Watch your language, man!
entries.JA_new: 言葉に気をつけろ！

entries.EN: Screw you! Get the fuck outta here, jack-off!
entries.JA_current: Screw you! Get the fuck outta here, jack-off!
entries.JA_new: うるせえ！　とっとと失せろ、このクソ野郎！

entries.EN: Greetings!
entries.JA_current: Greetings!
entries.JA_new: ようこそ！

entries.EN: Welcome, stalker.
entries.JA_current: Welcome, stalker.
entries.JA_new: よく来たな、ストーカー。

entries.EN: Don't let the guys get to you. It's the first time they got in a mess like that and they are just doing their best to cope. Don't be surprised if they're a bit resentful and unsociable right now.
entries.JA_current: Don't let the guys get to you. It's the first time they got in a mess like that and they are just doing their best to cope. Don't be surprised if they're a bit resentful and unsociable right now.
entries.JA_new: 連中の態度は気にしないでくれ。こんな事態は初めてで、みんな何とか受け止めようとしてる。今は少し腹を立てて、よそよそしくしていても大目に見てやってくれ。

entries.EN: I suppose you're the recon squad that has been sent for the missing stalkers?
entries.JA_current: I suppose you're the recon squad that has been sent for the missing stalkers?
entries.JA_new: 行方不明のストーカーを捜しに来た偵察部隊か？

entries.EN: That's ok, I understand. You have come for the missing squad, haven't you?
entries.JA_current: That's ok, I understand. You have come for the missing squad, haven't you?
entries.JA_new: そうか、分かった。行方不明の分隊を捜しに来たんだな？

entries.EN: Yes. They went down in there, military raid got them real good. We don't have the numbers around here to contend with them.
entries.JA_current: Yes. They went down in there, military raid got them real good. We don't have the numbers around here to contend with them.
entries.JA_new: ああ。地下へ降りたところをミリタリーに襲われて、ひどくやられた。ここにいる人数じゃ、奴らには対抗できない。

entries.EN: Military raid? Why? Are they searching for something down there again?
entries.JA_current: Military raid? Why? Are they searching for something down there again?
entries.JA_new: ミリタリーの襲撃だって？　なぜだ？　また地下で何かを探しているのか？

entries.EN: To be perfectly frank with you, I don't give a shit what they're after. We only came here to get our boys back. You're welcome to poke around and find out, we ain't gonna stop you. We'll be heading back to base to resupply and get reinforcements anyway, but one sharpshooter will remain behind just to observe troop movements. Shame we couldn't manage to retrieve the bodies of our comrades, but I just don't want to risk any more of our lads at this point... \n \nRight, enough chatter, we've gotta make preparations. If you make up your mind to go into the tunnels, speak to my sniper first. He's around here somewhere.
entries.JA_current: To be perfectly frank with you, I don't give a shit what they're after. We only came here to get our boys back. You're welcome to poke around and find out, we ain't gonna stop you. We'll be heading back to base to resupply and get reinforcements anyway, but one sharpshooter will remain behind just to observe troop movements. Shame we couldn't manage to retrieve the bodies of our comrades, but I just don't want to risk any more of our lads at this point... \n \nRight, enough chatter, we've gotta make preparations. If you make up your mind to go into the tunnels, speak to my sniper first. He's around here somewhere.
entries.JA_new: 率直に言うと、ミリタリーが何を探しているかなんて知ったことじゃない。俺たちは仲間を連れ戻しに来ただけだ。好きに調べてくれ。止めはしない。補給と増援を受けるため、俺たちは基地へ戻る。部隊の動きを監視するため、狙撃手を一人ここに残していく。仲間の遺体を回収できなかったのは残念だが、これ以上仲間を危険にさらしたくない……\n \nよし、おしゃべりはここまでだ。準備を始めないとな。トンネルへ行くことにしたら、まず俺の狙撃手に話しかけろ。近くにいるはずだ。

entries.EN: I will.
entries.JA_current: I will.
entries.JA_new: ああ、そうする。

entries.EN: Maybe later.
entries.JA_current: Maybe later.
entries.JA_new: また後でな。

entries.EN: I'll let him know you're coming, then. He doesn't talk to strangers.
entries.JA_current: I'll let him know you're coming, then. He doesn't talk to strangers.
entries.JA_new: 来ることは狙撃手に伝えておく。あいつは知らない相手とは話さないからな。

entries.EN: Good.
entries.JA_current: Good.
entries.JA_new: よし。

entries.EN: No way! It ain't normal at all to be that impudent! I'd treat'em to a couple of punches, but don't want to soil my hands.
entries.JA_current: No way! It ain't normal at all to be that impudent! I'd treat'em to a couple of punches, but don't want to soil my hands.
entries.JA_new: とんでもない！　あそこまで生意気なのは普通じゃない。二、三発殴ってやりたいが、手を汚すのはごめんだ。

entries.EN: You are beside yourself too, as far as I see.
entries.JA_current: You are beside yourself too, as far as I see.
entries.JA_new: あんたも、かなり頭に血が上ってるようだが。

entries.EN: What's up, man? Look, there's something I wanna chat about... You've skulked down into the tunnels recently, haven't you?
entries.JA_current: What's up, man? Look, there's something I wanna chat about... You've skulked down into the tunnels recently, haven't you?
entries.JA_new: どうした？　ちょっと話がある……最近、地下トンネルにこっそり入っただろ？

entries.EN: Why, are you planning to go down there?
entries.JA_current: Why, are you planning to go down there?
entries.JA_new: どうしてだ？　あんたも地下へ行くつもりか？

entries.EN: Yes, I am.
entries.JA_current: Yes, I am.
entries.JA_new: ああ、そのつもりだ。

entries.EN: I wouldn’t advise it unless you’ve got solid protection against explosives. All the remaining soldiers descended there after combat. And... they seem to have mined the entrance. Our guys cleared a couple of explosives, but still more could remain.
entries.JA_current: I wouldn�t advise it unless you�ve got solid protection against explosives. All the remaining soldiers descended there after combat. And... they seem to have mined the entrance. Our guys cleared a couple of explosives, but still more could remain.
entries.JA_new: 爆発物への備えが万全じゃないなら、やめておけ。戦闘の後、残っていた兵士は全員地下へ降りた。それで……入口に爆薬を仕掛けたらしい。仲間がいくつか解除したが、まだ残っているかもしれない。

entries.EN: Damn it! Looks like I'll have to find an armoured suit or some artifacts with explosion resistance.
entries.JA_current: Damn it! Looks like I'll have to find an armoured suit or some artifacts with explosion resistance.
entries.JA_new: くそっ！　装甲服か、爆発に強いアーティファクトを探すしかないな。

entries.EN: That's the only way.
entries.JA_current: That's the only way.
entries.JA_new: それしかない。

entries.EN: Don't shoot! Don't shoot at me, please!
entries.JA_current: Don't shoot! Don't shoot at me, please!
entries.JA_new: 撃たないで！　お願い、撃たないで！

entries.EN: Calm down! I wasn't planning on it.
entries.JA_current: Calm down! I wasn't planning on it.
entries.JA_new: 落ち着け！　撃つつもりはない。

entries.EN: Thank God, I have been shot at too much already... W-What about all the soldiers down there? Have... Have you killed them? I heard a lot of shooting, and... Oh, man, you saved my life! Thank you, thank you so much! You're my hero, come closer, let me hold you!
entries.JA_current: Thank God, I have been shot at too much already... W-What about all the soldiers down there? Have... Have you killed them? I heard a lot of shooting, and... Oh, man, you saved my life! Thank you, thank you so much! You're my hero, come closer, let me hold you!
entries.JA_new: 神様、助かった……もう撃たれるのはうんざりだ……あ、あそこにいた兵士たちは？　あなたが……殺したのか？　銃声がたくさん聞こえて……ああ、命を救ってくれたんだな！　ありがとう、本当にありがとう！　あなたは英雄だ！　こっちへ来て、抱きしめさせてくれ！

entries.EN: Whoa there! Restrain your lust, darling! "Modesty is the policy for a lady", heh.
entries.JA_current: Whoa there! Restrain your lust, darling! "Modesty is the policy for a lady", heh.
entries.JA_new: おっと、待った！　情熱は抑えろよ、お嬢さん！　「淑女のたしなみは慎み」ってね、はは。

entries.EN: No, I wasn't.. I mean, I just wanted to express my gratitude.
entries.JA_current: No, I wasn't.. I mean, I just wanted to express my gratitude.
entries.JA_new: いえ、そうじゃなくて……感謝を伝えたかっただけです。

entries.EN: A "thank you" is quite enough. You better tell me why the soldiers wanted to kill you.
entries.JA_current: A "thank you" is quite enough. You better tell me why the soldiers wanted to kill you.
entries.JA_new: 礼を言うだけで十分だ。兵士たちがお前を殺そうとした理由を話してくれ。

entries.EN: I wondered that myself, to be honest...
entries.JA_current: I wondered that myself, to be honest...
entries.JA_new: それは、私も気になっていました……

entries.EN: What do you mean?
entries.JA_current: What do you mean?
entries.JA_new: どういう意味ですか？

entries.EN:
Well, here's the thing. I am... Or rather, I was... the head of a research team that was sent into the Zone to retrieve some type of classified scientific material. We were attached to a military escort and sent to a discreet underground facility called X-18. This was an official assignment recognized by the government and the military, objectives known only to myself and the commander of the task force. When we arrived on site, one squad of soldiers went down into the lab itself and the rest remained upstairs with us. 
 
Then, something happened that really creeped me out. I accidentally eavesdropped on a conversation between a few of the soldiers and from what I could gather, they repeatedly uttered the code name "ZNOY-13", you see, that was the name of the objective that only myself and the commander were supposed to be aware of! I moved closer and heard them discussing the price, mentioning fantastically huge sums. I became alerted and went off to speak to a senior colleague from the science team but he had gone off somewhere to take readings. I got rather far away looking for him when I heard gunfire back in the direction of the hangar. I rushed back and cautiously peeped inside... 
 
Jesus, I will never forget that sight... The soldiers were executing my helpless colleagues, finishing off the wounded with head-shots... I panicked and tried to flee, but I must've made a noise or something because they spotted me. I ran like I've never ran before in my life! Despite the environmental suit I managed to make it far before I got out of breath. I dashed across a swamp and I think I miraculously made it through some type of anomaly, because the soldiers could not follow in their army uniforms. After a while, I just couldn't go any further in this environmental suit, it was hard to breathe and I was drowning in my own sweat. So, I jumped under a manhole cover near some industrial ruins and here I am. 
 
It was here that I realized I took a shot to the arm, and what I thought to be my sweat was actually my blood, I felt no pain from all the adrenaline in my system. I have been sitting snug here since, licking my wounds with one of those fancy med kits they give to all science teams operating in the Zone while the military searched for me. Didn't take them long to come down into the tunnels after me, following a trail of blood, no doubt! There was a lot of shooting earlier, even before you came, and I heard a couple of soldiers through an air-vent mention that two scientists had escaped, so I knew that one of my colleagues at least had made it out alive besides me, and they hadn't got him either. It's got to be my friend who went off to take readings! I've got to find him, I won't leave him behind in this hell!

entries.JA_new:
実は……私は、いや、私はかつて、機密扱いの科学資料を回収するためゾーンへ派遣された研究班の責任者でした。ミリタリーの護衛部隊とともに、X-18という秘密の地下施設へ向かったのです。政府と軍が認めた正式な任務で、目的を知っていたのは私と部隊の指揮官だけでした。現地に着くと、兵士の一分隊が研究所へ降り、残りは私たちと地上に残りました。
 
その後、ぞっとすることが起きました。兵士たちの会話を偶然盗み聞きしたのですが、彼らは何度も「ZNOY-13」というコードネームを口にしていました。それは、私と指揮官だけが知っているはずの任務名だったのです！　近づいて聞くと、彼らは値段の話をしていて、とんでもない大金を口にしていました。私は不審に思い、科学班の上級研究員に話を聞こうとしましたが、測定に出たまま戻っていませんでした。彼を捜してかなり遠くまで行ったところ、格納庫の方から銃声が聞こえました。急いで戻り、中を慎重に覗くと……
 
イエス様、あの光景は一生忘れません……兵士たちは、無力な同僚を処刑していたんです。負傷者にも頭を撃ち込んで、とどめを刺していました……私はパニックになって逃げようとしましたが、音を立てたのか見つかってしまいました。人生であんなに走ったことはありません！　環境保護スーツを着ていたのに、息が切れるまでかなり走れました。沼地を駆け抜け、奇跡的に何かのアノマリーを通り抜けられたようです。軍服姿の兵士たちは追ってこられませんでした。しばらくすると、このスーツではもう進めなくなりました。息苦しく、自分の汗で溺れそうだったんです。それで工場跡の近くにあったマンホールの下へ潜り込み、今に至ります。
 
ここで、腕を撃たれていたことに気づきました。汗だと思っていたのは血だったんです。アドレナリンのせいで痛みは感じませんでした。軍が捜している間、ゾーンで活動する科学班に支給される高性能な救急キットで傷を手当てしながら、ここに身を潜めていました。血痕をたどって、すぐに兵士たちもトンネルへ降りてきました。間違いないでしょう！　あなたが来る前から銃声が響いていて、通気口越しに兵士が「科学者が二人逃げた」と話すのを聞きました。私以外にも、少なくとも一人は生きて逃げ延びたと分かったんです。捕まってもいない。測定に出た友人に違いありません！　必ず見つけます。この地獄に置き去りにはできません！

entries.EN: Alright, alright, relax. Well, that explains what happened to the guys from Duty, they happened to come down here at the same time as the military goons who were searching for you, shit luck...
entries.JA_current: Alright, alright, relax. Well, that explains what happened to the guys from Duty, they happened to come down here at the same time as the military goons who were searching for you, shit luck...
entries.JA_new: 分かった、落ち着け。これでデューティーの連中に何があったか分かった。お前を捜してたミリタリーのならず者たちと、同じ時に地下へ降りちまったんだな。運が悪かった……

entries.EN: What do you mean? What guys are you talking about? "Duty", you said?
entries.JA_current: What do you mean? What guys are you talking about? "Duty", you said?
entries.JA_new: どういうことですか？　誰の話をしているんです？　デューティーって？

entries.EN: I was sent here after some dudes, it doesn't matter. By the way, you mentioned something about money?
entries.JA_current: I was sent here after some dudes, it doesn't matter. By the way, you mentioned something about money?
entries.JA_new: 仲間を捜しに来たんだ。まあ、それはいい。ところで、金の話をしていたな？

entries.EN: Huh, that's it!? That's the only thing in my story that peaked your interest!?
entries.JA_current: Huh, that's it!? That's the only thing in my story that peaked your interest!?
entries.JA_new: えっ、そこだけ？　私の話で興味を持ったのは金のことだけですか？！

entries.EN: Well... Money is always an interesting topic to follow.
entries.JA_current: Well... Money is always an interesting topic to follow.
entries.JA_new: まあ……金の話はいつだって興味深いからな。

entries.EN: Money and loot is the only thing that matters to you stalkers, isn't it? And here I was beginning to believe you were different... You're no different from those military bastards!
entries.JA_current: Money and loot is the only thing that matters to you stalkers, isn't it? And here I was beginning to believe you were different... You're no different from those military bastards!
entries.JA_new: ストーカーにとって大事なのは金と戦利品だけなのか？　君は違うと思い始めていたのに……ミリタリーのクソ野郎どもと変わらないじゃないか！

entries.EN: Hey, relax, I was kidding, I'm not here because of the money. I was sent after those Duty guys, remember? Although, admittedly, I am getting sick and tired of running through the muck up and down the Zone. I dream of a house by the river and... Okay okay, just joking, damn! Look, I'm going to look into this affair for you, and this "ZNOY-13" of yours, alright?

entries.EN:
Well, let me start from the very beginning. Initially the "ZNOY-13" was not intended as a weaponized virus. It was being developed as part of a research project against HIV. Generally speaking, "ZNOY-13" is a hybrid between a genetically engineered, artificial virus and the HIV virus. The artificial virus is not dangerous by itself. The human immune system deals with it easily due to the primary structure of the virus being based on the common cold, very widespread in the natural environment. 
 
But this engineered virus has got an outstanding feature added into its DNA - it can modify the structure of other viruses by means of genetic manipulation. The idea was simple, the engineered virus was exposed to the target virus in the lab in order to prime it, after which the hybrid was to be administered to the patient at which point it would migrate around the body and seek out the remainder of the target virus, changing it into a structure more reminiscent of the common cold. This would allow the patient's own immune system to terminate the hybrid virus with absolute effectiveness. 
 
In theory, this hybrid would act as a form of advanced vaccine which would help the body to overcome any illness, but instead of affecting a person's macrophages, we would be affecting the target virus itself, eliminating any defensive capabilities it had! The primary virus was stumbled upon by accident in an obscure genetic engineering project with little to no funding, and it has since grown to enormous proportions, enough to gain the interest of the government. The project was seized and the direction of study directed towards military applications. As you can imagine, helping people is not on the military's agenda. They quickly forgot the original application and focused instead on a convenient side-effect. 
 
After penetrating into the human body, "ZNOY-13" had a tendency to accumulate around certain brain segments and parts of the central nervous system, binding with them chemically and inducing an insensitivity to pain, but without affecting sensation and motor control - the military applications of such an effect were obvious, and they cared little for long-term side effects, deciding at once that they should inoculate the forces with it. What they didn't realize was that in the vast majority of cases the virus heavily suppressed the mental performance and acuity of the carrier. 
 
Half of the test subjects would lose even basic survival reflexes like the need to breathe, certain death without a ventilator. The remainder of survivors would gradually degrade into a state of severe mental handicap. A very small handful could escape with minor alterations to their nervous system and dulled pain, it is this group that had the military so interested. Unfortunately, whatever the outcome, there is no cure. The effect is neurodegenerative by nature and the alterations to the nervous system appear to be permanent and progressive...

entries.JA_new:
では、最初から説明しましょう。当初、「ZNOY-13」は兵器化ウイルスとして開発されたものではありません。HIV対策の研究計画の一環で作られました。簡単に言えば、遺伝子操作で作られた人工ウイルスとHIVを組み合わせたものです。人工ウイルス自体に危険性はありません。基本構造は自然界に広く存在する風邪のウイルスをもとにしており、人間の免疫系が容易に処理できるはずでした。
 
しかし、この人工ウイルスにはDNAに組み込まれた特別な性質がありました。遺伝子操作によって、ほかのウイルスの構造を変えられるのです。仕組みは単純です。まず実験室で対象となるウイルスに人工ウイルスを接触させ、作用させます。それから患者に投与すると、体内を巡って対象ウイルスの残りを探し、風邪に近い構造へと変えていく。そうすれば、患者自身の免疫系がハイブリッドウイルスを確実に排除できるはずでした。
 
理論上、このハイブリッドはあらゆる病気に打ち勝つための高度なワクチンとして働くはずでした。人間のマクロファージに作用させるのではなく、標的ウイルスそのものを変化させ、防御能力を失わせるのです！　元となるウイルスは、資金もほとんどない無名の遺伝子工学計画で偶然発見されました。その後、政府が注目するほど大規模な計画へと膨らみました。計画は接収され、研究の方向性は軍事利用へと変えられたのです。想像できるでしょうが、軍の目的に人助けはありません。彼らは本来の用途をすぐに忘れ、都合のいい副作用に目をつけました。
 
「ZNOY-13」は人体に入ると、脳の一部や中枢神経の周辺に集まり、化学的に結合する傾向がありました。感覚や運動機能には影響せず、痛みだけを感じにくくさせるのです。そんな効果の軍事利用がすぐに思いつく一方で、軍は長期的な副作用をほとんど気にせず、兵士に投与することを決めました。大多数の被験者で、ウイルスが思考力や知的能力を大きく損なうとは気づかなかったのです。
 
被験者の半数は、呼吸のような基本的な生存反射さえ失います。人工呼吸器がなければ確実に死ぬでしょう。残る生存者は、徐々に重い知的障害へと進行します。ごく一部だけは神経系への影響が軽く、痛みが鈍くなる程度で済みました。軍が関心を持ったのはこの一群です。残念ながら、どのような結果になっても治療法はありません。神経変性を引き起こす性質があり、神経系への変化は永続し、進行するようです……
